import pathlib
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p = ROOT / 'src/codegen_support/runtime/data/user.rs'
lines = p.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
start = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('fn emit_trace_exactness_flag('))
end = next(i for i in range(start, len(lines)) if lines[i].rstrip() == '}')
lines[start:end + 1] = [
    'fn emit_trace_exactness_flag(out: &mut String, has_user_frames: bool) {\n',
    '    let exact = usize::from(!has_user_frames);\n',
    '    out.push_str(".globl _rt_trace_exact\\n_rt_trace_exact:\\n");\n',
    '    out.push_str(&format!("    .quad {}\\n", exact));\n',
    '}\n',
]
p.write_text(''.join(lines))
print('flag function rewritten')
